title: Akkadian poultice recipes
eyebrow: CTH 808 · Babylonian therapeutic text copied at Ḫattuša

dating.label: Ḫattuša copy, 14th–13th c. BCE (approx.)
dating.note: An Akkadian medical tablet from Boğazköy with Hittite and Hurrian glosses; this dates the manuscript context, not the Babylonian recipes.

purpose: Treat a sick man with alternative herbal poultices bandaged on repeatedly, followed by a fragmentary purification.
attribution: Anonymous Babylonian medical recipes with Hittite and Hurrian scribal glosses
editionLabel: Hethitologie-Portal Mainz concordance, CTH 808; F. Köcher, KUB 37 (1953)

phases.name: Recipe: kasû-juice poultice
phases.idea: Plants crushed, boiled in kasû-juice and bandaged on.

phases.name: Recipe: beer poultice
phases.idea: Plants crushed and decocted in beer like a rabīku-paste.

phases.name: Recipe: wine poultice
phases.idea: About thirty aromatics crushed, mixed with emmer flour, decocted in wine and bandaged on.

phases.name: Recipe: ghee poultice
phases.idea: Seeds mixed with ghee and beer and bandaged on.

phases.name: Purification (fragmentary)
phases.idea: A fragmentary purification of the sick man.

steps.title: Crush the plants and mix them as one
steps.shortDescription: Crush ḪA.AB-plant, Ú.RA.AN.NA, juniper, an aromatic and ninû-plant, and mix them together.
steps.summary: Crush ḪA.AB-plant, Ú.RA.AN.NA, juniper, an aromatic and ninû-plant, and mix them together.
steps.evidence: KUB 37.1 ¶0; one aromatic name is broken.

steps.summary: Boil the crushed mixture in kasû-juice.

steps.title: Boil in beer and decoct like a rabīku-paste
steps.shortDescription: Crush cress, fenugreek and other plants, boil them in first-quality beer and decoct them like a rabīku-paste.
steps.summary: Crush cress, fenugreek and other plants, boil them in first-quality beer and decoct them like a rabīku-paste.
steps.evidence: KUB 37.1 ¶1; the Hittite gloss renders the cooking as 'like a ḫuwarti-'. ¶2 repeats the procedure with other plants and is not mapped.

image.alt: Crush cress, fenugreek and other plants, boil them in first-quality beer and decoct them like a rabīku-paste.
image.note: Illustrative reconstruction; form and appearance beyond the text are conjectural.

steps.title: Crush many aromatics with a wooden crusher
steps.shortDescription: Crush some thirty woods, aromatics and plants (cedar, myrtle, juniper, myrrh, tamarisk and others) with a wooden crusher.
steps.summary: Crush some thirty woods, aromatics and plants (cedar, myrtle, juniper, myrrh, tamarisk and others) with a wooden crusher.
steps.evidence: KUB 37.1 ¶3; the Hittite gloss ('pestle(?) and mortar(?)') is uncertain; count is approximate. A scribal gloss admits not knowing ṣalabita-wood.

image.alt: Crush some thirty woods, aromatics and plants (cedar, myrtle, juniper, myrrh, tamarisk and others) with a wooden crusher.

steps.title: Perform a purification for the sick man
steps.shortDescription: Perform a purification (takpirtu) for the sick man, apparently with a ḫulduppû, bind him(?) and keep doing so for two or three months.
steps.summary: Perform a purification (takpirtu) for the sick man, apparently with a ḫulduppû, bind him(?) and keep doing so for two or three months.
steps.evidence: KUB 37.1 ¶8 is very fragmentary: the purification, the ḫulduppû (substitute animal?) and binding are only partly legible; no sequence is reconstructed.
